concepts.label: Infant photograph challenge
concepts.definition: Photographing infants presents unique challenges, with the goal being the best likeness that can reasonably be obtained.
concepts.quote: Infants pose a particular challenge. The goal is the best likeness that can reasonably be obtained

unit_attributes.statement: Infants pose a particular challenge, and the goal is the best likeness that can reasonably be obtained.

concepts.label: Infant closed eyes
concepts.definition: Acceptability of partially or completely closed eyes in photographs of infants and newborns.
concepts.quote: acceptable if the infant's eyes, particularly a newborn's, are partially or completely closed

unit_attributes.scope_text: For photographs of infants, particularly newborns, where the goal is the best likeness reasonably obtainable.
unit_attributes.object_quote: the infant's eyes, particularly a newborn's
unit_attributes.object: the infant's eyes, particularly a newborn's

qualifications.statement: Applies if the infant's eyes, particularly a newborn's, are partially or completely closed.

unit_attributes.statement: It is acceptable if the infant's eyes, particularly a newborn's, are partially or completely closed.

concepts.label: Infant head support
concepts.definition: Discreet support for an infant's head during photography.
concepts.quote: The infant's head may be discreetly supported

unit_attributes.statement: The infant's head may be discreetly supported, e.g., a car seat with a white or off-white blanket behind the child.

concepts.label: Infant head tilt
concepts.definition: Acceptability of head tilt in photographs of infants.
concepts.quote: Head tilt is acceptable for infants

unit_attributes.statement: Head tilt is acceptable for infants.

concepts.label: Parent face prohibition
concepts.definition: Prohibition against a parent's face appearing in an infant's photograph.
concepts.quote: A parent’s face cannot be in the photograph of the infant

unit_attributes.scope_text: In the photograph of an infant.
unit_attributes.action_quote: be in the photograph of the infant
unit_attributes.action: be in the photograph of the infant
unit_attributes.statement: A parent’s face cannot be in the photograph of the infant.

concepts.label: New photograph request
concepts.definition: Duty to request a new photograph when submitted photograph fails requirements.
concepts.quote: You must request a new photograph if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements

unit_attributes.scope_text: When the submitted photograph does not meet the specified requirements.

qualifications.statement: Applies if the photograph submitted does not meet the specified requirements.

unit_attributes.statement: You must request a new photograph if the photograph submitted does not meet the specified requirements.

concepts.label: Color photograph requirement
concepts.definition: Mandate that submitted photographs must be in color.
concepts.quote: The photograph must be in color

unit_attributes.statement: The photograph must be in color.

concepts.label: Photograph timing and likeness
concepts.definition: Standard for photograph recency, likeness, and identification of the applicant.
concepts.quote: The photograph should be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application

typed_values.name: photograph_timeframe
typed_values.quote: within six months of submitting the application

unit_attributes.logic_text: within six months of submitting the application
unit_attributes.action_quote: be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application
unit_attributes.action: be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application
unit_attributes.statement: The photograph should be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application (see 22 CFR 51.26).

concepts.label: Change in hairstyle or facial hair
concepts.definition: Acceptability of changes in hairstyle or facial hair from identification documents.
concepts.quote: A photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted is acceptable if it still is a good likeness of the applicant

unit_attributes.scope_text: For a submitted photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted.
unit_attributes.logic_text: if it still is a good likeness of the applicant
unit_attributes.object_quote: A photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted
unit_attributes.object: A photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted

qualifications.statement: A photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted is acceptable if it still is a good likeness of the applicant.

unit_attributes.statement: A photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted is acceptable if it still is a good likeness of the applicant.

concepts.label: Passport photograph re-use
concepts.definition: Possibility that applicants may seek to re-use a photograph from a citizenship or naturalization certificate.
concepts.quote: Applicants may wish to re-use a passport photograph that is depicted on their submitted U.S Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization

unit_attributes.scope_text: For applicants submitting a U.S. Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization.
unit_attributes.object_quote: a passport photograph that is depicted on their submitted U.S Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization
unit_attributes.object: a passport photograph that is depicted on their submitted U.S Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization
unit_attributes.statement: Applicants may wish to re-use a passport photograph that is depicted on their submitted U.S Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization.

concepts.label: Certificate photograph recency risk
concepts.definition: Potential that a photograph on a certificate may not satisfy the six-month recency recommendation due to processing times.
concepts.quote: the photograph may not have been taken within six months of submitting the application

typed_values.name: photograph_validity_limit
typed_values.quote: within six months of submitting the application

unit_attributes.scope_text: For photographs depicted on a submitted U.S. Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization, even if the certificate itself was recently issued.
unit_attributes.logic_text: within six months of submitting the application
unit_attributes.statement: Even if the certificate itself was recently issued, because of U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services processing times, the photograph may not have been taken within six months of submitting the application.
